dessin: A round stamp of a standard, as a simple map legend symbol: one flat pale disk #FBFCF8 outlined by two thin concentric ink #23281F circles close together (a double rule), and one smaller plain ink circle inside them; the inner disk is completely empty plain pale paper. Sharp crisp lines, no scalloped edge, no ribbons, no rosette, no star, no flag, no maple leaf, no crown, no coat of arms, no national or provincial emblem, no letters, no numbers. Nothing else.
